As Apple (AAPL) Share Price Declined, Holder Northstar Group Lifted Stake; Permit Capital Has Increased Its Gamestop New (GME) Stake by $2.07 Million; Stock Declined
May 26, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Permit Capital Llc increased its stake in Gamestop Corp New (GME) by 21.11% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Permit Capital Llc bought 122,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 24.11% with the market. The hedge fund held 700,000 shares of the electronics distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $12.57M, up from 578,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Permit Capital Llc who had been investing in Gamestop Corp New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.29 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.55% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $12.67. About 2.44M shares traded. GameStop Corp. (NYSE:GME) has declined 33.43% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 44.98% the S&P500.
Northstar Group Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 14.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northstar Group Inc bought 4,017 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 31,734 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.37M, up from 27,717 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northstar Group Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
